summary: Federal Communications Commission should preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program to ensure reliable broadband access for schools and libraries. The claim is for preserving the E-Rate program to ensure access to connectivity for students and schools, emphasizing the importance of the program for modern education and technology needs.

claims.argument: Reject proposals to sunset or eliminate E-Rate
claims.evidence_quote: I therefore respectfully urge the Commission to: Reject any proposal to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program;
